data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to send/receive SMS, make phone calls, and retrieve network parameters on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to interact with Android telephony features, including sending and querying SMS messages, listening for incoming SMS in the foreground or background, fetching network parameters and SIM states, and initiating phone calls.
use_when: You need to send or read SMS messages programmatically on Android.
You need to listen for incoming SMS messages in the foreground or background.
You need to query network metrics, SIM state, or cellular data parameters.
avoid_when: Your application targets iOS (this plugin currently only works on the Android platform).
You only need cross-platform URL launching for phone calls without SMS querying or listening features.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set covering SMS querying, sending, and conversations.
Supports background execution for incoming SMS messages.
Provides access to network metrics and device telephony parameters.
weaknesses: Limited to the Android platform only.
Requires manual configuration of permissions and broadcast receivers in AndroidManifest.xml.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding necessary permissions (e.g., SEND_SMS, READ_SMS, RECEIVE_SMS) and registering the BroadcastReceiver in AndroidManifest.xml.
